lines: What if everyone on Earth suddenly spoke the same language?
Today, humans speak around seven thousand languages.
Most of us can only talk to a small slice of the world.
A lost tourist asks for directions, and understands every word.
Strangers on a train start chatting.
And kids from anywhere can share the same joke.
The good news: travel gets easy.
Scientists and doctors share discoveries instantly.
The bad news: translators and language teachers lose their jobs overnight.
And thousands of languages fall silent, taking their songs, poems, and jokes with them.
Sharing words doesn't mean sharing opinions.
Give it a few generations, and new slang and accents would start pulling us apart again.
So, would one language unite the world, or just make it less colorful?
